ai.desc: Claude creates new questions for your level and language in real time. You can use it up to 20 times a day, and if something goes wrong the app switches to built-in questions automatically.
ai.inviteHint: To turn on AI mode, you need the invite code from the person who shared this app.
ai.inviteWrong: That invite code is not correct
ai.inviteLimit: Too many attempts. Please try again tomorrow
ai.inviteError: Could not reach the server. Please try again later
ai.fallbackError: Couldn't load AI questions, so you'll get built-in questions
ai.fallbackLimit: You've reached today's AI limit, so you'll get built-in questions
ai.fallbackInvite: The invite code changed, so AI mode was turned off. Using built-in questions
